definitions.canonicalTask: One printed exercise subpart or one unpartitioned question. A multiple-choice question is one task. Independently captioned figures in G9 Ex 1.3 Q6 are three tasks. Grade 9 Ex 6.3 has one unnumbered stem and four subparts.
definitions.fullCoverage: The provisional task totals include extracted subparts whose following-line grouping requires a visual review. No completion percentage or fully completed English/Tamil totals are asserted.
definitions.implemented: Registered runtime has question, solution and answer fields in both languages, and the current candidate source mapping is identifiable. Text presence alone is separate from source/Math/Tamil editorial verification.
definitions.partial: Possible missing language fields or unconfirmed mapping or overlapping record candidates. Some are legitimate bundles or contain mathematical answers shared across language modes.
definitions.missing: No matching registered browser record for the candidate task. Ambiguous labels need a page-to-card review before authoring.
definitions.sourceBlocked: A non-unique, contradictory or insufficiently specified source problem with a documented locator or prior audit.
definitions.verified: The rollup counts rerun Grade 9 Geometry and Frontier verifications, plus exact Grade 10 runtime IDs linked to matching page-visual manifests and rerun mathematical tests. Absent optional hint, table, and diagram metadata is not a claim the feature is unavailable.
definitions.editorial: Independent Tamil editorial certification and teacher approval are pending.
